mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the INDPRO index, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation higher and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: INDPRO index drops by > 2% MoM but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts, as measured by the HOUST series, signals a weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST drops by > 10% MoM but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 4% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months, it signals a weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises by > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth accelerates by more than 2 percentage points year-over-year and the unemployment rate is below 5%, it signals an overheating economy that will drive inflation higher and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth > 2pp and UNRATE < 5% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4% and the CPI inflation rate is above 3%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL > 3% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.
